items.q: Do I need to know anything about blockchain?
items.a: No. Nobody does, not you, not your students, not the person checking. You'll see email, links and a dashboard. The heavy cryptography stays where it belongs: out of sight.
Your credentials keep working. They're built on open standards, so they can be exported and verified without us. We think that's the only honest way to build this.

items.q: Can my recipients mess it up?
items.a: There's nothing to mess up. They get an email with a link. That's the whole experience, no wallet, no password, no app to install.
In normal, GDPR-compliant storage that can be edited or deleted, never on anything public or permanent. Only tamper-proof fingerprints are anchored publicly.
Issuing is priced so any institution can afford it; heavy verification is billed per check. Design partners get generous early terms, that could be you.
